thread:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH latency on /v1/generate for hosted-prod (p99 > 1.2s) — 45% errors in last 3m. Escalation: oncall-sre

Ava Chen: I'm on the page, joining the call now. seeing a spike across multiple clusters?

Liam O'Neill: I get p50 ok, but p95/p99 blown up. errors look like 503 backend failures and some timeout 504s. Any recent deploys?

Priya Patel: No prod deploys in last 4 hours. We did push a config change to sampling for traces (~2h ago) but that shouldn't affect serving.

Samira Gomez: adding initial customer-impact note: some API keys report timeouts; simplest repro is a batch generation with longer context > 1024 tokens. A few big customers on dedicated are affected.

Ava Chen: Good to know. Liam, can you grab logs from prod-ingest for the 1784002000-1784002468 window? I can start timeline building.

Liam O'Neill: Running query in ES 
```
GET /prod-logs/_search
{
  "query": {"range": {"@timestamp": {"gte": "1784002000","lte": "1784002468"}}},
  "size": 500
}
```
But ES shows a lot of missing traces for request_id fields. Sampling looks low. I'm only seeing ~20% of requests present.

Priya Patel: That matches my suspicion — the trace sampling change accidentally toggled a global flag. I toggled it in staging only but the feature flag rollout touched prod because of an env var mismatch.

Marta Rivera: If logs are missing due to sampling we've got an observability gap. We need higher-fidelity logs for the next 30m to track root cause. Suggest toggling debug sampling for the /v1/generate route for 30 mins. That will increase costs but is necessary.

Samira Gomez: +1. Also we should add temporary structured fields to logs for model_variant and kv_cache_hit so we can correlate latency to cache behavior.

DevOpsBot: Runbook check: to increase sampling for runtime: `POST /admin/flags/sampling` with body `{ "route": "/v1/generate", "sample_rate": 1.0, "duration_sec": 1800 }` — requires admin-token.

Ava Chen: I'll execute the change now. Executing:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://config.internal/admin/flags/sampling -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","sample_rate":1.0,"duration_sec":1800}'
```
Responded 200. sampling=1.0 for 30m.

Liam O'Neill: After enabling full sampling I'm seeing additional logs. Correlation looks like KV cache misses correlate strongly with p99. Example log line: `request_id=abc123 model=gptx-13b seq_len=2048 kv_cache_hit=false backend_latency_ms=940`

Priya Patel: Confirmed. There's a spike in requests with seq_len>1600 and kv_cache_hit=false. Those take full autoregressive runs. Could be cache eviction or wrong cache key due to new hashing change?

Ava Chen: Timeline so far: 17:32 — trace sampling rollout change; 18:00 — first customer errors; 18:14 — alert fired (this thread). Need to check if any kernel/quantization changes rolled to dedicated pools.

Samira Gomez: I pulled allocator logs from runtime-controllers — saw frequent cache TTL evictions around 18:10. Config shows kv_cache_ttl set to 10m but eviction count exploded. Possible bug in ttl-renew logic.

Marta Rivera: Hypotheses (in-thread):
1) Sampling flag caused missing logs making diagnosis slower (observability gap).
2) A recent config drift toggled KV cache TTL/keys causing mass misses.
3) Increased long-context requests (seq_len spike) exposed worst-case perf and caused backend saturation.

Liam O'Neill: Adding evidence: query to metrics DB for seq_len distribution:
```
SELECT histogram_bucket, count FROM token_hist WHERE ts BETWEEN 1784001500 AND 1784002468 ORDER BY bucket DESC LIMIT 10;
```
Shows sharp increase in >1500 bucket starting 18:05.

Priya Patel: Cross-check with recent customer activity — one client launched a batch job at 18:03 with large contexts. So hypothesis 3 has weight.

Ava Chen: Mitigations in flight:
- Increase worker concurrency on dedicated pools for short term (Liam)
- Temporarily enforce max_seq_len=1024 for hosted tier (Priya)
- Enable extra logging (done) and capture tail traces for 1h (Marta)

Please confirm when done.

Liam O'Neill: Scaling workers up now: `k scale deploy/runtime-pool-prod --replicas=40` — done, pods coming up. Noted some cold starts but should help throughput.

Priya Patel: Applying soft cap for hosted: updating request middleware to reject >1024 with 429+Retry-After 30s for 15m window. Patch applied to gateway, rolling now.

Samira Gomez: Customer impact note: applying throttling will cause errors for a few heavy customers. I've drafted a customer message for affected accounts, adding it to support channel now.

DevOpsBot: Action logged: incident/1784002468 mitigation steps recorded. Paging resolved? still 503s but reduced to baseline in last 6m.

Ava Chen: We should still track RCA artifacts: missing logs due to sampling = observability gap. Need follow-ups:
- Postmortem section: why sampling flag staged to prod (owner, change ID)
- Dashboard fixes: add a panel for kv_cache_hit ratio by model_variant and seq_len bucket
- Alerts: add a detection rule for rapid rise in seq_len > 1500 rate
- Logging: ensure request_id is always emitted even when sampling=0

Marta Rivera: I'll own the dashboards and alert change. Assigning ETA EOD.

Priya Patel: I'll dig into the TTL-renew code for kv cache — opening a PR/branch and will link here.

Liam O'Neill: I'll prepare timelines and upload a sanitized subset of logs to the incident board for RCA. Note: because of initial low sampling we have incomplete trajectories for ~30% of requests — we should call that out in postmortem.

Samira Gomez: Oncall handoff in 20 minutes — @Liam O'Neill will take next-stage lead. I'm staying for the customer comms handover.

incident-bot: Incident Severity: HIGH -> downgraded to MEDIUM at 1784005600. Duration: ~46m.

Ava Chen: Thanks, team. Final note: we must avoid toggling global flags from staging pipelines; add a safety to require prod toggle approval. Adding to action items.

Liam O'Neill: Copy, will include in RCA. Saving logs and closing this thread for now — will reopen if we see recurrence. :white_check_mark:
